title: Polynomial-Time Pairing with the Input
statement: Let $f$ be a polynomial-time computable function from bit strings to bit strings. The function sending each bit string $x$ to the pair encoding of $f(x)$ and $x$ is polynomial-time computable.
replaced:
If a function $f$ on binary strings is polynomial-time computable, then so is the
function $x \mapsto \mathrm{pair}(f(x), x)$ pairing the computed value with the
original input.
